experiments.name: high-unroll load-to-ALU chain
experiments.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.d $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, -8; st.d $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r5, 0x7fffffffffffffff
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.d $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, -8; st.d $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r5, 0x7fffffffffffffff' --asm 'ldle.d $r4, $r20, $r5; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'

latencies.notes: 1 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 4.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent addresses
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r21, $r20, 0; addi.d $r23, $r20, 8; addi.d $r24, $r20, 16; addi.d $r25, $r20, 24; addi.d $r26, $r20, 32; addi.d $r27, $r20, 40; addi.d $r28, $r20, 48; addi.d $r29, $r20, 56; addi.d $r30, $r20, 1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'ldle.d $r12, $r21, $r30; ldle.d $r13, $r23, $r30; ldle.d $r14, $r24, $r30; ldle.d $r15, $r25, $r30; ldle.d $r16, $r26, $r30; ldle.d $r17, $r27, $r30; ldle.d $r18, $r28, $r30; ldle.d $r19, $r29, $r30'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes: 7.98 core cycles per 8 instructions, CPI 1. Slope method (--unroll 1000, --unroll2 2000).

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
